_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_data" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "brewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "grinder_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "dripper_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "filter_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bean_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "roast_level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bean_weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "grind_size" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "taste" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "concentration" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "temperature" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "blooming_water" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_water" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "blooming_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_fragrance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_acidity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_bitterness" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_sweetness" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_complexity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_flavor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "score_overall" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "comment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "grinder_image_url" TEXT NULL, "dripper_image_url" TEXT NULL, "filter_image_url" TEXT NULL, "bean_image_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bean_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "roast_level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "store" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image_url" TEXT NULL, "bean_image_url" TEXT NULL, "info_image_url" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "first_use_date" TEXT NULL, "last_use_date" TEXT NULL, "is_in_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_in_stock" IN (0, 1)), "initial_quantity_grams" REAL NULL, "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "roast_date" TEXT NULL, "stock_baseline_grams" REAL NULL, "stock_baseline_at" TEXT NULL, "storage_location" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "seek_optimal_conditions" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("seek_optimal_conditions" IN (0, 1)), "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "methods_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "base_bean_weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "base_water_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "temperature" REAL NULL, "grind_size" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "recommended_equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_url" TEXT NULL, "recommended_roast_level" TEXT NULL, "recommended_roast_min" TEXT NULL, "recommended_roast_max" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pouring_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "step_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "water_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "water_reference" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "water_ratio" REAL NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mill_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "grind_range" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dripper_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "material" TEXT NULL, "shape" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "filter_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "material" TEXT NULL, "size" TEXT NULL, "image_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "origin_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "name_ja" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "region" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "store_master" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '-', "formal_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "prefecture" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "has_online_shop" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_online_shop" IN (0, 1)), "has_physical_store" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_physical_store" IN (0, 1)), "has_roastery" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_roastery" IN (0, 1)), "bean_tendency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "memo" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image_url" TEXT NULL, "sns_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "business_hours" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "closed_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "opened_year" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "info_fetched_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bean_purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bean_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "purchased_at" TEXT NULL, "roast_date" TEXT NULL, "quantity_grams" REAL NULL, "store_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "store_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "memo" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analysis_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "data_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_suggestions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "bean_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "roast_level" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "temperature" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "brew_ratio" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "total_time_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rationale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "accepted" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "result_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_coffee_data_brewed_at ON coffee_data (brewed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_coffee_data_bean_id ON coffee_data (bean_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_coffee_data_method_id ON coffee_data (method_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bean_master_store_id ON bean_master (store_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bean_master_origin_id ON bean_master (origin_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pouring_steps_method_id ON pouring_steps (method_id, step_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_bean_purchases_bean_id ON bean_purchases (bean_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_analysis_history_type ON analysis_history (type)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_suggestions_bean_id ON recipe_suggestions (bean_id)
